Evidence / output: Discover: interview the owner, collect permitted facts and time the current manual process.
Scope: agree one goal, audience, channel, deliverables, exclusions and spending ceiling.
Prepare: approve script, storyboard, references, voice permissions and asset register.
Build: create several visual candidates and narration takes; record every paid attempt, not only accepted ones.
Evaluate: assemble an edit, correct captions and audit every claim, visual implication and rights record.
Release: obtain written approval of exact final files and publish on the agreed real channel only if authorised.
Operate: observe seven days of permitted analytics and feedback; correct or withdraw misleading material.
Hand over: deliver editable files, exports, source/rights records, actual costs and a repeatable checklist.
